description: We're Kernel Panic Squad, a team of backend and automation engineers. We build real-time monitoring systems, APIs and dashboards (Python, FastAPI, Docker, Grafana), and we want to apply that to astronaut health: turning sensor data into live insights and early-warning alerts. Looking for teammates with skills in frontend (React/Vue), data science/ML, UI/UX design, or biomedical knowledge. Let's build something NASA-worthy!
